dataset_source.title: Sampling the materials space for conventional superconducting compounds
dataset_source.attribution: Source data: Tiago F. T. Cerqueira, Antonio Sanna and Miguel A. L. Marques, Sampling the materials space for conventional superconducting compounds, Materials Cloud 2023.163 v1, DOI 10.24435/materialscloud:qv-bq, CC BY 4.0. This catalogue is a derived projection with additional source-state screening commentary.

scope: Previously private source-model screening is now published as unscored source-computed material-design hypotheses. Historical private-screening wording is retained as context. These predictions are new to this reviewed catalogue only; experimental confirmation, worldwide first discovery, formal RPS and human scientific review are not claimed.
source_tc_scope: Source isotropic Eliashberg Tc in K at mu*=0.1 is a model result, not experimental Tc. It is a separate source product and is not associated with an individual Gaussian width or a numerical uncertainty interval.
pairing_response_scope: Retained ten-width lambda contrasts and independent source Tc products support bounded source-model comparisons. Chemical, mass, volume, sampling, spin and SOC effects can co-change; no universal causal or error-bound interpretation is assigned.
risk_tag_scope: Attention labels support browsing. Element labels are not measured magnetic ground states, rejection criteria or calibrated potential scores; no label does not mean no risk.

candidate.prototype: Pm-3 ordered A15-derived eight-site network: six Nb in one chain-site orbit, unique Ga and Rh corner/body-center roles
candidate.prototype_evidence: Pm-3 ordered A15-derived eight-site network: six Nb in one chain-site orbit, unique Ga and Rh corner/body-center roles
candidate.support_meaning: Preliminary screened support within the stated source model. This ordinal level is not a probability, formal RPS score or human scientific review.
candidate.risk_summary: The exact target has no signed negative sampled-path values or negative optical compression. Order/disorder, competing A15 compositions and a martensitic/CDW branch remain the relevant risks; the fine force 0.033558 eV/A and early eigen warnings are preserved. GaNb6Sb is better at all sigma values and remains a retained opposite control. The small minimum effect and changed ecutwfc require a common-cutoff falsifier, rather than an asserted numerical significance bound.
candidate.ambient_scope: Both source SCFs converge, near-zero coarse forces/stress and bounded fine response are measured. Fine Fmax=0.033558041 eV/A, P=0.062 GPa, full max stress=0.062 GPa. Gamma optical compression is positive beyond printing bound and sampled path has no signed negative values. All listed q outputs have JOBDONE/last response convergence and no routine errors. This supports a finite-grid local/metastable source model, not global hull or experimental synthesis.
candidate.route_response: Ga replaces Al at the unique Al/Ga site while all six Nb-chain and Rh roles remain mapped. Cell volume contracts 0.5193% and nearest Nb-Nb falls 0.0158926 A. The coupled ordered-site/chain construction gives a modest but same-sign 3.796–18.373% lambda improvement and separate Eli mu=.1 13.213 to 14.014 K. It is not proof of pure compression or higher mobile carrier density.
candidate.next_action: Compare the retained Ga/Al site roles at common cutoff/PP family and volume, quantify Nb-chain response and test order/CDW stability. A stable persistent gain supports this narrow hypothesis; disappearance within common sampling or a chain instability opposes it.

seven_criteria.identity: Complete ordered CIF/literal coarse-fine input/Gamma periodic species-site association is numerically supported; source input geometry and full tensor/forces are retained. Export occupancy is a discrete computational convention; source experimental P/T/occupancy and actual compiled unit constant are unknown. Exact-version input defaults scope the configured neutral scalar spin1/noSOC model, not magnetic ground state.
seven_criteria.quantitative_route_response: Ga replaces Al at the unique Al/Ga site while all six Nb-chain and Rh roles remain mapped. Cell volume contracts 0.5193% and nearest Nb-Nb falls 0.0158926 A. The coupled ordered-site/chain construction gives a modest but same-sign 3.796–18.373% lambda improvement and separate Eli mu=.1 13.213 to 14.014 K. It is not proof of pure compression or higher mobile carrier density.
seven_criteria.pairing_relevance: Exact target and mapped control direct source lambda arrays have the same favorable sign at all ten common broadening tokens; omega_ln has explicit K units and separate Eli/McM mu=.1 tables remain independent. Same underlying q mesh is observed. The sensitivity range is not a physical error bound; sigma units, full-BZ convergence, experimental Tc and pure-geometry causality remain unknown. Literal method differences are declared confounds.
seven_criteria.ambient_feasibility: Both source SCFs converge, near-zero coarse forces/stress and bounded fine response are measured. Fine Fmax=0.033558041 eV/A, P=0.062 GPa, full max stress=0.062 GPa. Gamma optical compression is positive beyond printing bound and sampled path has no signed negative values. All listed q outputs have JOBDONE/last response convergence and no routine errors. This supports a finite-grid local/metastable source model, not global hull or experimental synthesis.
seven_criteria.competition_and_coherence: The exact target has no signed negative sampled-path values or negative optical compression. Order/disorder, competing A15 compositions and a martensitic/CDW branch remain the relevant risks; the fine force 0.033558 eV/A and early eigen warnings are preserved. GaNb6Sb is better at all sigma values and remains a retained opposite control. The small minimum effect and changed ecutwfc require a common-cutoff falsifier, rather than an asserted numerical significance bound.
seven_criteria.novelty: Known Nb3Ga and mixed A15 B-site superconductors establish the family prior, not this fully ordered Pm-3 Nb6GaRh state. Dated 2026-10-07 exact Nb6GaRh/Nb6GaSb/Nb6PdPt queries found no exact experimental superconducting match. Novelty is the single Ga-for-Al ordered-source construction hypothesis, not discovery of superconductivity in Nb-rich alloys.
seven_criteria.decision: Compare the retained Ga/Al site roles at common cutoff/PP family and volume, quantify Nb-chain response and test order/CDW stability. A stable persistent gain supports this narrow hypothesis; disappearance within common sampling or a chain instability opposes it.
